options.summary: Retain D1-D21 for predecessor lineage and add six separately keyed domain overlays for all supplemental surfaces and candidates.

authorized_scope: Read the accepted F0 foundation, accepted c3 current-fact supplement, current Phase 3 disposition plan, and exact authority records through explicit content identities.

Enumerate the exact 47 current package surfaces, all 985 predecessor-route keys, all 471 supplemental-candidate keys, the accepted D1-D21 predecessor partition, and prerequisite edges without applying support or compatibility outcomes.
Present exactly three materially distinct defensible disposition-coverage architectures, their ownership and sequencing consequences, and one reasoned recommendation for later human selection.

Produce one exact-structure advisory architecture-decision document and one canonical reconciliation checkpoint proposal whose recommended map assigns every current surface and supplemental candidate exactly once or explicitly defers it under a named owner, while preserving each predecessor route's accepted D1-D21 lineage.

Run deterministic cardinality, uniqueness, identity, prerequisite-acyclicity, neutral-claim, ownership, projection, formatting, typing, and whitespace checks followed by one independent architecture review and one independent integration review.
Stop for a separate human decision after review; keep the accepted Phase 3 plan and all D1-D21 Task records unmodified and inactive.
completion_criteria: The decision packet binds exact accepted input identities and accounts for all 47 current surfaces, 985 predecessor routes, and 471 supplemental candidates with no duplicate, omission, alias, or silent reassignment.

All 985 predecessor routes retain their accepted D1-D21 cohort, and new surfaces or supplemental candidates remain separately keyed rather than being silently folded into D1 or rewriting predecessor lineage.

The advisory decision document uses the required architecture-decision structure, presents exactly three materially distinct defensible architectures with explicit consequences, and identifies one recommendation without recording it as a human decision; the concise checkpoint proposal offers A, B, C, and D — Reconsider or defer.

The recommended map has explicit ownership for every surface and candidate, an acyclic prerequisite graph, and no support, compatibility, public-API, scientific-validation, release, or publication conclusion.

The no-argument completion validator passes canonical decoding, input identity, cardinality, uniqueness, coverage, lineage, graph, lifecycle, ownership, Harness projection, static typing, formatting, and whitespace checks.
Independent architecture and integration reviews report no blocking finding, after which the task stops for separate human selection without amending the Phase 3 plan or activating D1-D21.
request.decision_question: Produce bounded, reviewed decision support for reconciling the accepted D1-D21 disposition partition with all 47 current package surfaces and 471 separately keyed supplemental candidates while preserving the 985 predecessor-route lineage and making no support or compatibility decision.
no_mutation_boundary: Do not classify any route as supported or unsupported or assign a compatibility disposition.

Do not modify F0, the accepted current-fact supplement, the accepted Phase 3 plan, package initializers, production source, tests, resources, public documentation, dependencies, lockfiles, calculations, or publication content.
Do not record or activate D1-D21, M1, an implementation child, V1, Phase 4, or automatic successor activation.
Do not merge or otherwise incorporate a later development-branch change into the accepted c3 fact target within this task.
Do not commit or push before separate human acceptance of the reviewed reconciliation result.
